title: Two-sided scalar-recentering corridor and harmonic BRST transfer

recentering_corridor.ground_energy_bracket: c_g N^2<=E_N<=6gC_N^2-(1-o(1))g sigma_N R_N with R_N=N^(1/14)/(1+log N)
recentering_corridor.low_side: Every a_N=o(N^2), and more generally every shift uniformly below the proved c_g N^2 boundary by a divergent margin, sends the spectral bottom to plus infinity
recentering_corridor.high_side: Every shift whose descent below 6gC_N^2 is asymptotically smaller than g sigma_N R_N sends the spectral bottom to minus infinity along K1516's normalized tilt trials
recentering_corridor.surviving_corridor: A nontrivial uniformly semibounded limit can only be sought inside the nonmatching corridor between the proved Omega(N^2) lower boundary and the K1516 variational upper boundary; the exact ground-energy shift E_N+O(1) remains unresolved
recentering_corridor.brst_transfer: For mathbb H_N=H_N tensor 1+1 tensor Delta_BRST, inf spec(mathbb H_N)=E_N and harmonic compression is the matter resolvent tensored with P_harm, so both low-side collapse and high-side instability transfer without constructing a continuum interacting BRST charge
